message.reasoning: We need to answer from policy excerpts. The question: "Does a shared dashboard link stay live and update in real time, or does it only capture a snapshot at the time it's shared?" According to DOC-044 part 2: "The shared link stays live and updates in real time along with the dashboard itself — it is not a snapshot — so a stakeholder revisiting the link later sees current data rather than what it showed when the link was created." So answer: It stays live and updates in real time. Also mention that it can be revoked. But keep short.
